label: Spiral Boxes
blurb: The frame is divided into a grid of boxes and the incoming shot fills them one at a time, running round and round the grid in a spiral: either from the outside edge winding inward to the middle, or from the middle winding out to the edge. Each box snaps in with its own short fade, so the pattern reads as a run of tiles rather than a wipe. Set the grid, the way round, and how soon one box starts before the last one has finished.
